name: Rev. Dr. Chris Oyakhilome DSc DSc DD
title: President, LoveWorld Inc.
bio: Pastor Chris is the President of LoveWorld Incorporated (Christ Embassy). Born Dec 7, 1963, Edo State, Nigeria, he founded the Youth For Christ fellowship at Ambrose Alli University (then Bendel State University) in 1987 — the genesis of Believers' LoveWorld. He holds an Architecture degree (Bendel/Ambrose Alli) and honorary doctorates, and pioneered LoveWorldSAT — Africa's first 24/7 Christian satellite network broadcasting to 100+ nations.
mandate: Taking the divine presence of God to the nations and demonstrating the character of the Spirit — through the Word, the Spirit, media, and global missions.
